subject: MTTR target for Optimize config rollback + GA readiness checklist
body:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Allison Grant <allison.grant@redwoodinference.com>, Aisha Bello <aisha.bello@redwoodinference.com>, Tomáš Novák <tomas.novak@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jan 14, 2025 at 8:12 AM
Subject: MTTR target for Optimize config rollback + GA readiness checklist

Team,

Following up on the recent config-change incident threads (#incidents + #eng-oncall) and the Safe apply + rollback work.

For GA we need an explicit MTTR target and a minimum operational readiness bar. Proposed targets (for Hosted + Dedicated; Private can be documented separately but should be in-family):

1) Detect & decide: 0–5 min (on-call sees elevated error/latency + correlation to config change)
2) Execute rollback: <= 2 min (one-click rollback from Console or API)
3) Recovery confirmation: <= 10 min total (metrics back within gates + propagation shows fully applied)

So: MTTR <= 10 minutes from “bad config identified” to “recovered + confirmed.”

Before we call anything GA-ready, SRE needs:
- Runbook completeness: clear decision tree, dashboards to check, what to do if rollback fails/partially propagates, and escalation path.
- Dashboards: a dedicated config-change/rollback dashboard, and panels that correlate “version applied” events with p95 latency, error rate, saturation.
- Alerts: config apply failure rate, rollback failure rate, stuck rollouts (status doesn’t converge), and “config change + latency spike” heuristics where possible.

Can we align on (a) whether the MTTR target above is realistic, and (b) what specifically blocks us from reaching it?

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
SRE Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Allison Grant <allison.grant@redwoodinference.com>, Aisha Bello <aisha.bello@redwoodinference.com>, Tomáš Novák <tomas.novak@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jan 14, 2025 at 9:01 AM
Subject: Re: MTTR target for Optimize config rollback + GA readiness checklist

+1 on formalizing this.

The 10 min MTTR feels achievable *if* we have:
- a single “rollout status = converged” signal that’s reliable
- a dedicated dashboard with: (1) last config version applied per scope, (2) error/latency deltas, (3) link to rollback action

Today, the manual steps from the last thread were:
1) find the change (took ~10 min across logs + guessing scope)
2) figure out last known-good (no history)
3) manual revert in a config editor (and hope it propagated)

So the biggest win is: remove the “find last good + revert” hunting.

Runbook request: please make sure it includes a “rollback didn’t help” section (cache warmup / capacity) so on-call doesn’t thrash.

Rafael
On-call owner (SRE)

From: Allison Grant <allison.grant@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Aisha Bello <aisha.bello@redwoodinference.com>, Tomáš Novák <tomas.novak@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jan 14, 2025 at 10:22 AM
Subject: Re: MTTR target for Optimize config rollback + GA readiness checklist

On dashboards/alerts:

We should scope the GA bar to a small set of high-signal alerts rather than trying to boil the ocean.

Minimum set I recommend:
1) optimize_config_apply_attempt_total / optimize_config_apply_failed_total (rate + ratio)
2) optimize_config_rollback_attempt_total / optimize_config_rollback_failed_total
3) optimize_config_rollout_stuck (status not converged within X minutes)
4) “post-change regression” alert (optional for GA): if we can correlate change events to sharp p95/error shifts, great, but I’d rather not gate GA on this if it’s noisy.

Also: make sure the events include correlation IDs and scope dimensions (customer_id, region, route/model) so Grafana can slice.

If the control plane can emit a single “version_applied” event w/ tags, the dashboard becomes straightforward.

Allison
Observability Standards

From: Aisha Bello <aisha.bello@redwoodinference.com>
To: Allison Grant <allison.grant@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Tomáš Novák <tomas.novak@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jan 14, 2025 at 11:05 AM
Subject: Re: MTTR target for Optimize config rollback + GA readiness checklist

Agree with Allison.

Practical note from the SLO dashboards side: we need a canonical place to click from “badness” -> “what changed.”

If the dashboard has a panel that shows the last N config version changes (time series annotations), plus a deep link to the rollback UI, the MTTR goal becomes realistic.

If you want GA to be gated, I’d suggest requiring:
- dashboard exists + on-call can find it from the runbook in < 30 seconds
- at least one alert wired to page (or at minimum, to the on-call channel) for stuck rollouts

Aisha
SLO dashboards + alert gates

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Allison Grant <allison.grant@redwoodinference.com>, Aisha Bello <aisha.bello@redwoodinference.com>, Tomáš Novák <tomas.novak@redwoodinference.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jan 14, 2025 at 12:18 PM
Subject: Re: MTTR target for Optimize config rollback + GA readiness checklist

This is consistent with what we’re building.

Current status:
- Rollback endpoint w/ idempotency + audit events is in review (PR 10457)
- Runtime propagation status is being plumbed (we can expose “converged vs in-progress vs failed” per scope)
- Console rollback UI is showing progress, but the “blast radius” + “last known-good” UX is still being refined.

Blocking for MTTR <= 10 min:
1) Need the rollout status to be trustworthy (no “green but actually only half the fleet updated”). This is mostly runtime + control plane integration.
2) Need the dashboard + alert rules in place (ENG-4828 + observability-pack PR 733).

If SRE can define the concrete GA checks for the runbook (e.g., “confirm these 3 panels”), we can tailor the Console post-rollback checklist to match.

Dylan
Eng Lead, Console/Tooling

Date: Tue, Jan 14, 2025 at 2:47 PM
Subject: Re: MTTR target for Optimize config rollback + GA readiness checklist

I can take first pass on the runbook updates.

Plan:
- Add “triage & decide” section: confirm config change occurred + confirm scope (customer/region/route/model)
- Add “execute rollback” section: one-click rollback steps (Console + API)
- Add “validate recovery” checklist: which dashboard panels + what thresholds constitute “recovered”
- Add “rollback failure modes” section: partial propagation, rollback rejected by RBAC, cache warmup/latency, etc.
- Add explicit escalation: runtime on-call + platform on-call + when to declare incident

If someone can send me the current dashboard link (even placeholder), I’ll reference it directly.

Tomáš
Runbooks + incident process hardening

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tomáš Novák <tomas.novak@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>, Allison Grant <allison.grant@redwoodinference.com>, Aisha Bello <aisha.bello@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Jan 15, 2025 at 4:38 PM
Subject: Re: MTTR target for Optimize config rollback + GA readiness checklist

Thanks all.

Decision / asks:

1) MTTR target: we’ll set GA target to <= 10 minutes from “decision to rollback” to “confirmed recovered,” measured during a game day and at least one real on-call execution in lower env. (We can add a separate “time to decision” metric later; it’s too variable.)

2) GA readiness requirements (must-have):
- Runbook published + reviewed by SRE (Tomáš owning; Rafael reviewer)
- Dashboard published in our standard folder + linked from runbook (Aisha/Allison owning)
- Alerting for apply/rollback failure + stuck rollout posted to on-call channel at minimum (paging policy TBD)

3) Engineering owners:
- Dylan/Chloe: ensure rollout status is not best-effort; we need a clear “converged” definition for the runbook + dashboard.

Tomáš: please draft the runbook by EOW; we’ll do a 20-min review in the on-call sync.

Sean
